3. The petitioner herein (hereinafter referred to as the writ - petitioner) filed the above mentioned writ petition before the High Court Division challenging Memo No. ভূঃ/মঃ/শা-৯/(নামজারী)/১৩/০৬-১৪৯০ তারিখঃ ৯.১১.২০০৬ issued under the signature of the Assistant Secretary, section- 9 of the Ministry of Land addressed to the Deputy Commissioner, Chittagong with copy to the Assistant Commissioner (Land), Sitakunda, Chittagong and Niranjan Das, son of Kutishwar Das, 20 Ice Factory Road, Police Station - Double Mooring, Chittagong directing them to accept rent from the applicant Anjuman-E-Ittihad Baitush Sharaf (writ-respondent No.6) in respect of 140.22 acres land situated within the District-Chittagong, Police Station Sitakunda, Mouza-Uttar Jungle Shonachhari, D.S. Khatian No.7, B.S. Plot No.2. In the writ petition direction was also sought upon writ respondent Nos.1- 5 for receiving rent from the writ petitioner in respect of said 140.22 acres land (hereinafter referred to as the disputed land) and the Rule Nisi was issued accordingly. 

 6. The writ-petitioner by filing a supplementary affidavit stated that the disputed land was gifted to his father for use of religious and charitable purpose by three registered deeds and accordingly, B.S. Khatian was prepared in his name; the Ministry concerned passed an executive order directing the lower authority to mutate the land and receive rents from writ-respondent No.6 through its representative, Niranjan Das and such order could not be passed without correction of B.S. Khatian through a competent civil court.
